purpose: Photographic evidence for the PHYSICAL layout of the Weltzeituhr drum. Each record is a dated photograph contributing layout constraints. Names alone are not the object; band and within-face order are.
contamination_note: Historical photographs are admissible object evidence. No claimed-K4-solution site used. See docs/contamination-log.md.
CRITICAL_GEOMETRY_RULE: The city cylinder is STATIC; the hour ring ROTATES. An hour numeral appearing beneath a face therefore does NOT identify that face's time zone. Identify a face from its CITY CONTENTS and physical adjacency only. A record may carry visible_hour_ring_values, but they must never be used to assign utc_sector.
transcription_rule: Never force an ambiguous letter. Use '?' for an uncertain character and UNKNOWN for an unreadable name. The modern 146-name list may RAISE confidence in a blurry reading but never independently proves a historical inscription.
environment_limitation: This agent cannot fetch or view any of these images: commons.wikimedia.org, upload.wikimedia.org, www.bundesarchiv.de and live.staticflickr.com all return HTTP 000 under the egress policy. Transcriptions below marked USER-ASSERTED were supplied by the user and could NOT be independently re-transcribed here. Images uploaded into the session as files CAN be read and transcribed directly.

stability_question.statement: Did any inscription or layout change occur BETWEEN 1969 and 1997?
stability_question.why_it_matters: If layout is stable across decades, the far larger pool of 1970s-80s photographs becomes usable for reconstructing the 1989 state, massively expanding available evidence.

stability_question.rule: Do NOT assume 1969 layout equals 1989 layout merely because both predate 1997.

candidate_accessions.note: Bundesarchiv Bild 183 (ADN) Weltzeituhr frames located by search but NOT viewable in this environment and NOT yet dated. Listed so a human can pull them directly.

accession_structure.observed: Modern-form accessions read 183-YYYY-MMDD-frame, e.g. 183-1989-0830-028 (30 Aug 1989). Older ADN accessions read 183-<LETTER>MMDD-frame, e.g. 183-H1218-0025-001.
accession_structure.inference: The LETTER encodes the year and MMDD the month/day. INFERRED, not sourced.
accession_structure.internal_check: 183-H1218-0025-001 is captioned 'Winter'. H1218 -> 18 December, which is winter. The MMDD reading is consistent with the caption.
